shortDescription: Set Time/Date parameters in WTI OOB and PDU devices.

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: date
options.description: Static date in the format of two digit month, two digit day, four digit year separated by a slash symbol.

options.name: ipv4address
options.description: Comma separated string of up to two addresses for a primary and secondary IPv4 base NTP server.

options.name: ipv6address
options.description: Comma separated string of up to two addresses for a primary and secondary IPv6 base NTP server.

options.name: ntpenable
options.description: This enables or disables the NTP client service.

options.name: time
options.description: Static time in the format of two digit hour, two digit minute, two digit second separated by a colon symbol.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Set the network timeout in seconds of contacting the NTP servers, valid options can be from 1-60.

options.name: timezone
options.description: This is timezone that is assigned to the WTI device.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
